QuestInfo.name: Recycling
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2152010##k told you that if you prove you know how to save, that he will give you a decent piece of armor.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152010# explained that people throw away lots of useful things in #b#t4032754##k, and so he wants to recycle those things to make your armor. Bring him #b30#k #b#t4032754#s#k by eliminating #r#o2150001#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought #t4032754#s to #p2152010#, and after rambling a bit about being frugal, gave you a pretty nice piece of armor. #p2152010# might be a bit of a pain, but he does good work, at least.

0.0: Smart kid. See, most people are always throwing away perfectly good items. It's disgraceful! Why, the #r#o2150001##k is FULL of stuff that anyone would be happy to have. You feel like going down there to see?

yes.0: Good! All righty, if you eliminate #r#o2150001##k monsters in #b#m310030300##k and bring me #b30 #t4032754##k items, I'll give you a decent piece of armor.

no.0: Eh, no respect for recycling. Shameful, that's what it is.

1.0: Done recycling? Doesn't it feel good?

yes.0: See, this is perfect. You get a decent piece of armor, and I get some quality junk. Everbody wins, right?

item.0: Where's all the good junk? Eliminate those #r#o2150001#s#k in #b#m310030300##k and bring #b30 #t4032754#s#k to me.
